mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT fmly_cd from tb_point_earn UNION SELECT DISTINCT fmly_cd from tb_point_using;
SELECT IFNULL((select fmly_cd from point_hist where cstmr_cd = #{cstmrCd} order by date_time desc limit 1),#{cstmrCd}) fmly_cd;

SELECT IFNULL(cstmr.point,0) + (IFNULL((SELECT sum(point_hist.point) FROM point_hist where point_hist.fmly_cd = #{fmlyCd} and point_hist.point_status='P'),0) - IFNULL((SELECT sum(point_hist.point) FROM point_hist where point_hist.fmly_cd = #{fmlyCd} and point_hist.point_status='M'),0)) total_point , (#{fmlyCd}) fmly_cd , (select cstmr_name FROM cstmr WHERE cstmr_cd=#{fmlyCd}) fmly_name FROM cstmr where cstmr.cstmr_cd=#{fmlyCd};

SELECT date_time ,(select datetime from sale_off where sale_id= H.sale_id) as sale_date , fmly_cd , IF(H.cstmr_cd='expired','유효기간만료',(select cstmr_name from cstmr C where C.cstmr_cd = H.cstmr_cd)) cstmr_name , point , IF(point_status='M', '사용', '적립') point_status FROM point_hist H WHERE fmly_cd=#{fmlyCd} and point!=0 order by date_time desc, point_id desc;

SELECT point_id , sale_id , cstmr_cd , fmly_cd , point , shop_num , date_time , point_status ,(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = (select shop_id from sale_off where sale_id = P.sale_id)) as shop_name FROM point_hist P WHERE point_status='M' and left(date_time,7) = left(#{dateTime},7) group by fmly_cd
SELECT point_id , sale_id , cstmr_cd , fmly_cd , point , shop_num , date_time , total_point , m_point , cstmr_point FROM point_monthly

SELECT point_id , sale_id , cstmr_cd , fmly_cd , point , (select shop_id from sale_off where sale_id = P.sale_id) as shop_id , date_time , point_status FROM point_hist P WHERE fmly_cd=#{fmlyCd} and left(date_time,7) <= left(#{dateTime},7) order by point_id desc;
